newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Industrial Saltillo started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Industrial Saltillo started.

text.p: ING Barings said on Thursday it initiated coverage of Grupo Industrial Saltillo SA de CV with a buy rating, as the Mexican conglomerate is expected to increase sales by 20 percent by 1998.
-- Analyst Daniel Goldstein said in a research note he expected sales to increase partly because of larger auto supply contracts.

-- "With NAFTA (North American Free Trade Agreement), the company took a dominant position in Mexico's auto parts and engine manufacturing and now plans to expand its engine block capacity by 30 percent by the end of 1997," he said.
-- The company's adjusted earnings were also expected to increase by 20 percent in 1998 after a flat performance in 1997, Goldstein said.
